[[Major/Legends|Major]] '''Tso''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who commanded the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Viridian Squad]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Following the [[Battle of Rishi]], he was part of [[Satele Shan]]'s force that traveled to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and established the anti-[[Order of Revan|Revanite]] [[Yavin Coalition]] along with forces of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] under [[Darth Marr]]. During an excursion into [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] territory, the squad was ambushed, with [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Era Jung]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] and the rest taken captive. After a fellow Coalition member rescued the prisoners, they informed Major Tso of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Jung's death.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Major Tso appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
